content.description: Exploded view diagram of clutch master cylinder assembly showing all components including reservoir tank, mounting nut, piston, push rod, snap ring, master cylinder, boot, clevis, pin, clip, and clutch line union nut. Components are shown in disassembled order from left to right.

items:
DISCONNECT CLUTCH LINE UNION
Using SST, disconnect the union nut.
SST 09751-36011

REMOVE MASTER CYLINDER
(a) Remove the mounting nut and bolt.
(b) Pull out the master cylinder.

content.description: Illustration showing hands removing the cap from the reservoir tank of the clutch master cylinder assembly mounted on the vehicle.

items:
REMOVE RESERVOIR TANK
Remove the push down cap and pull off the reservoir tank.

REMOVE PUSH ROD AND PISTON
(a) Pull back the boot and, using a screwdriver, remove the snap ring.
(b) Pull out the push rod, washer and piston.

content.description: Illustration showing hands using a screwdriver to remove the snap ring from the master cylinder while holding back the boot. The internal spring and components are visible.

items: COAT PARTS WITH LITHIUM SOAP BASE GLYCOL GREASE, AS SHOWN
INSTALL PUSH ROD ASSEMBLY WITH SNAP RING

INSTALL RESERVOIR TANK
Torque: 250 kg-cm (18 ft-lb, 25 N·m)
